info.title: Quiet Ledger private API
info.description: Account-scoped API for invoices, receiving and read-only existing BTC/Ark observations. Local mode uses the separate owner workspace. No seed, signing, sending, spending, withdrawal, raw RPC, provider configuration or private scenario endpoints. x-required-scope is enforced by the bearer middleware. Manual confirmation and records export require separately provisioned scopes and have no default MCP tool. See MCP.md for hosted/local key setup, retry semantics and provider acceptance limits.
